d: Immerse yourself in a special double bill featuring both Carnatic and Hindustani music, rarely presented together in Indian classical festivals. Experience the maturity and musical power of Balachandran unleash in London for his UK visit. As a child prodigy, he has emerged as one of the most sought-after veena players of his generation. He provides a refreshing interpretation of Carnatic ragas with virtuositic agility. Kumar, a musician from the great Carnatic tradition, is quite simply one of the most outstanding performers of our era. He is praised for his technique, supreme musicality,…
